diagnoses.dsm_category: Medication-Induced Movement Disorders and Other Adverse Effects of Medication
diagnoses._notes: EMERGENCY: hyperthermia + rigidity + autonomic instability + ↑CK. Tx: stop antipsychotic, supportive, dantrolene/bromocriptine. DDx: serotonin syndrome.

diagnoses.dsm_category: Medication-Induced Movement Disorders and Other Adverse Effects of Medication
diagnoses._notes: EMERGENCY: clonus + hyperreflexia + agitation + autonomic + hyperthermia. Hunter criteria. Tx: stop offending agent, supportive, cyproheptadine. DDx: NMS (rigidity vs clonus).

diagnoses.dsm_category: Medication-Induced Movement Disorders and Other Adverse Effects of Medication
diagnoses._notes: Tx: anticholinergic IM (benztropine, diphenhydramine). Risk highest in young males.

diagnoses.dsm_category: Medication-Induced Movement Disorders and Other Adverse Effects of Medication
diagnoses._notes: Subjective restlessness + objective movements. Linked to suicidality. Tx: ↓dose, β-blocker (propranolol), benzo, mirtazapine, switch to lower-EPS antipsychotic.

diagnoses.dsm_category: Medication-Induced Movement Disorders and Other Adverse Effects of Medication
diagnoses._notes: Often irreversible. AIMS scale screening. Tx: VMAT-2 inhibitors (valbenazine, deutetrabenazine), switch to clozapine/quetiapine.

diagnoses.dsm_category: Medication-Induced Movement Disorders and Other Adverse Effects of Medication
Medication-Induced Movement Disorders and Other Adverse Effects of Medication
diagnoses._notes: EMERGENCY at >2.5: tremor → ataxia → confusion → seizures → death. Tx: hydration, hemodialysis if severe.

diagnoses.dsm_category: Medication-Induced Movement Disorders and Other Adverse Effects of Medication
key_subtypes: FINISH: Flu-like, Insomnia, Nausea, Imbalance, Sensory disturbances, Hyperarousal
diagnoses._notes: Differentiate from relapse. Tx: re-start + slower taper. Fluoxetine has lowest risk (long t½).
